title: UAAP: Draw with UST keeps Ateneo on track for Final 4
summary: Ateneo de Manila University stayed on track for a Final 4 spot in the UAAP Season 89 women's football tournament after battling to a 1-1 draw with University of Santo Tomas on Wednesday.
